title: Add no-route and transmit boundary failure tests for transactional handoff (needs test seam)
description: Bead project-LICHEN-worker6-shvq decomposition (tests portion 2). Gateway::dispatch_runtime_gcp (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1387-1401) rolls back a staged handoff whenever send_secure_response returns Err, but the no-route and transmit failure boundaries are untestable with current seams: lichen_hal::loopback::LoopbackRadio::transmit is Infallible (never fails), and RplStack::send_secure_response's NoRoute fallback (lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/secure.rs:142-154) always succeeds for an authenticated direct neighbor, so no deterministic injection point exists. Minimal-boring seam options to assess: (a) a test-only Radio wrapper whose transmit fails once, generic over Radio in RplStack/SecureStack (invasive), (b) a Gateway test constructor accepting a custom SenderStateStore for the sender store so a fail-after-first-success store can simulate post-persistence transmit failure, (c) unit-test the match arms at gateway.rs:1387 directly with a staged entry plus forced Err. Prefer the smallest seam; tests must assert the node stays registered and non-deleted (rollback), and remain retryable. Verify tests fail against a reverted (unregister-before-send) handoff implementation before trusting them.
close_reason: Wave 1: fix implemented and validated (tests green)
